# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Pocket Craft Grove: Block Builder** as a mobile-first portrait browser voxel sandbox inspired by Minecraft-style creative crafting. Preserve the mechanic truth of a first-person block world: split touch controls for move/look, center crosshair raycast, hotbar block selection, pickaxe mining, adjacent block placement, jump, creative flight toggle, chunked procedural terrain, collision, gravity, reset, and inventory/settings modals. Reinterpret the world as a cozy grove with a deep mine, natural blocks, torch warmth, procedural trees, blocky clouds, readable HUD, and player-driven maker goals. Target portrait viewports from 4:7 to 9:16 with large touch targets, readable labels, compact overlays, and browser-native Three.js rendering.

blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint: Pocket Craft Grove

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a browser-native Three.js first-person voxel sandbox. The player starts from a modal, enters a generated block terrain with an intentional central shaft, moves with a mobile split-zone scheme, looks with the right-side drag zone, taps/raycasts to place or mine blocks, jumps or toggles flight, selects hotbar slots, opens inventory/settings, collides with blocks, and receives depth/reset feedback.

## Protected Mechanics
- First-person camera, yaw/pitch look, split left/right touch controls, jump button, and flight toggle.
- Procedural chunk generation, block map storage, tree/rim generation, and cleanup by render distance.
- Raycast interaction against the center crosshair with reach limit.
- Slot 0 mines/removes blocks; other slots place adjacent blocks unless intersecting the player body.
- Axis-separated collision and gravity/fall loop behavior.
- Hotbar, inventory assignment, settings sliders, toast/feedback state flow, and reset flow.

## Remixed Target
Minecraft sandbox crafting. A Minecraft sandbox crafting game with block-building creativity, survival gathering, exploration, procedural discovery, player-driven goals, cozy persistence, and limitless maker energy with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The new canonical surface is **Pocket Craft Grove: Block Builder**, a cozy mobile portrait block-building fantasy where the player is a pocket crafter exploring a grassy voxel grove, mining with a pickaxe, placing grass/stone/log/leaves/brick/glass/torch/crate/boom crate, and using the existing infinite shaft as a deep mine discovery feature.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, palette, block names/icons/colors, lighting/fog, start screen, authored sky motifs, feedback labels, audio source choices, inventory copy, settings copy, and mobile readability styling are transformed while mechanics remain stable.
